name: get_search_console_performance
description: Google Search Console performance: clicks, impressions, CTR and average position by query, page or date for a date range, with optional query or page filters. Data lags about two days. Free.

name: inspect_url_in_google
description: Inspect URL in Google: Search Console's URL inspection for one page: whether it is indexed, coverage state, robots.txt and fetch status, and last crawl time. Google allows 2,000 inspections a day per property. Free.

name: list_sitemaps
description: List sitemaps submitted to Google Search Console for a property, with last submitted and downloaded times, pending state, warnings, errors and submitted URL counts. Free.

name: submit_sitemap
description: Free URL submission: resubmit a sitemap to Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools so both engines recrawl your pages. Resubmitting the same sitemap is safe. Free.

name: get_bing_webmaster_stats
description: Bing Webmaster stats: Bing search queries, pages, or daily traffic for a site, with impressions, clicks and average positions. Bing also powers DuckDuckGo results. Free.

name: get_bing_crawl_issues
description: Bing crawl issues: URLs Bing could not crawl properly for a site, with the issue type, HTTP code and inbound link count. Free.

name: get_bing_url_submission_quota
description: Bing URL submission quota: how many URLs this site can still submit to Bing today and this month through Bing Webmaster Tools. Free.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "search-console" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: inspect_url_in_google, list_sitemaps, submit_sitemap, get_bing_crawl_issues, get_bing_url_submission_quota · Public sink: submit_sitemap, get_bing_url_submission_quota.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: inspect_url_in_google, list_sitemaps, submit_sitemap, get_bing_crawl_issues, get_bing_url_submission_quota · Public sink: submit_sitemap, get_bing_url_submission_quota

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
